meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 该技能会安装 OneCLI、配置 Agent Vault 网关,把 .env 里的 Anthropic 等凭据迁入保险库,再从 .env 删除明文密钥,然后重新构建并重启服务,最后验证网关与日志。
howto.when: 在 /update-nanoclaw 引入 OneCLI 后,或首次搭建 OneCLI 时触发;也可直接要求“初始化 OneCLI”。若代码尚未适配 OneCLI,会先让你运行 /update-nanoclaw。

say.text: 初始化 OneCLI,把 .env 里的密钥迁进 Agent Vault。
say.note: 会安装 OneCLI 并迁移 Anthropic 凭据。

say.text: 检查 OneCLI 网关和已登记的密钥。
say.note: 会跑健康检查与 onecli secrets list。

say.text: 把 OPENAI_API_KEY 也迁到 OneCLI 保险库。
say.note: 会先询问是否迁移其他容器凭据。

howto.what_en: Installs OneCLI, configures the Agent Vault gateway, migrates existing credentials from .env into the vault, removes raw keys from .env, then rebuilds and restarts the service and verifies the gateway.
howto.when_en: Triggers after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or on first-time OneCLI setup.

say_en.text: Initialize OneCLI and migrate .env credentials into Agent Vault.
Check OneCLI gateway health and registered secrets.
say_en.note: Runs health check and secret list.
